decisions.reason: The transactional email cloud service was featured on the home page, which signals heavy investment and public commitment to the firm's announced cloud messaging direction, so management will persist with it.
Managed Capture Services has its own dedicated page and a named customer reference, so visible commitment and early success justify continuing it.
Email and fax conversion ties directly into Retarus' established fax and messaging infrastructure, so dropping it would release little and would contradict earlier decisions.
The fax delivery optimization feature is a low-cost add-on to the core fax business, and any weak uptake can be put down to temporary causes, so it is kept.
Sandbox threat protection is central to the firm's email security direction, and having already dropped the multi-engine virus scanning product, management will defend the security line it kept.
